pages.description: NOTE: Data on this page must match the information as it is written in your passport.

fields.label: Passport Photo Upload
fields.helpText: Upload a photo of your passport bio page to auto-fill your personal information.

fields.label: Surnames
fields.helpText: Enter all surnames as listed in your passport. If only one name is listed in your passport, enter that Surname.

fields.label: Given Names
fields.helpText: If your passport does not include a given name, please enter 'FNU' in Given Names.

fields.label: Full Name in Native Alphabet
fields.helpText: Enter your full name as written in your native alphabet, if applicable. Check 'Does Not Apply' if not relevant.

fields.label: Have you ever used other names (i.e., maiden, religious, professional, alias, etc.)?
fields.helpText: Other names used include your maiden name, religious name, professional name, or any other names which you are known by or have been known by in the past.

fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.helpText: If day or month is unknown, enter as shown in passport. Format: DD-MMM-YYYY.

fields.label: Country/Region of Birth
fields.helpText: Select the name that is currently in use for the place where you were born.

pages.description: NOTE: Provide the following information concerning your travel plans.

fields.label: Purpose of Trip to the U.S.
fields.helpText: Select the visa class that best describes your purpose for traveling to the United States.

fields.label: Specify
fields.helpText: Select the specific B visa subtype that applies to your trip.

fields.label: Specify
fields.helpText: Select the specific F visa subtype that applies.

fields.label: SEVIS Number
fields.helpText: Your SEVIS ID number is found on your Form I-20. It begins with the letter N.

fields.label: Intended Date of Arrival
fields.helpText: If you are unsure of your travel plans, please provide an estimate. Format: DD-MMM-YYYY.

fields.label: Intended Length of Stay in U.S.
fields.helpText: Enter the number of days, weeks, months, or years you plan to stay.

fields.label: Address Where You Will Stay in the U.S. — Street Address (Line 1)
Person/Entity Paying for Your Trip
fields.helpText: Select who will be paying for your travel expenses.

pages.description: NOTE: Provide the following previous U.S. travel information. Provide complete and accurate information to all questions that require an explanation.

fields.label: Have you ever been in the U.S.?
fields.helpText: Answer Yes if you have ever visited or lived in the United States for any reason.

fields.label: Provide information on your last five U.S. visits
fields.helpText: If you are unsure about when you visited the U.S., please provide a best estimate. Include date arrived and length of stay.

fields.label: Have you ever been issued a U.S. Visa?
fields.helpText: Include any visa type, even if expired. You will be asked for the date and visa number.

fields.label: Have you ever been refused a U.S. Visa, or been refused admission to the United States, or withdrawn your application for admission at the port of entry?
Has anyone ever filed an immigrant petition on your behalf with the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services?

pages.description: Review all your answers. Download your DS-160 preparation worksheet when ready.
